description: A JavaScript source file for visualizing memory usage and profiling data using D3.js. It includes functions for rendering memory segments, events, and user interactions, as well as unpickling and processing snapshot data.

classes.name: EventSelector
classes.description: Handles event selection and highlighting in the visualization.

classes.name: StackInfo
classes.description: Manages stack trace display and interaction.

classes.name: ContextViewer
classes.description: Displays context information for selected memory elements.

classes.name: MiniMap
classes.description: Provides a minimap overview for memory visualization.

classes.name: Legend
classes.description: Displays category legend for the visualization.

methods.name: version_space
methods.description: Creates a versioning function for addresses.

methods.name: Segment
methods.description: Constructs a memory segment object.

methods.name: Block
methods.description: Constructs a memory block object.

methods.name: formatSize
methods.description: Formats a number as a human-readable size string.

methods.name: formatAddr
methods.description: Formats an event address with version info.

methods.name: formatEvent
methods.description: Creates a string description of a memory event.

methods.name: eventStack
methods.description: Generates a detailed string for an event with stack info.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for a number.

methods.name: addStroke
methods.description: Adds a red stroke to a D3 element.

methods.name: removeStroke
methods.description: Removes stroke styling from a D3 element.

methods.name: calculate_fragmentation
methods.description: Calculates fragmentation metrics for memory blocks.

methods.name: create_segment_view
methods.description: Creates a view for memory segments and events.

methods.name: annotate_snapshot
methods.description: Annotates snapshot data with versions and categories.

methods.name: elideRepeats
methods.description: Elides repeated frames in stack traces.

methods.name: frameFilter
methods.description: Filters out uninformative stack frames.

methods.name: format_user_metadata
methods.description: Formats user metadata for display.

methods.name: format_frames
methods.description: Formats stack frames for display.

methods.name: process_alloc_data
methods.description: Processes snapshot data for memory allocation visualization.

methods.name: MemoryPlot
methods.description: Plots memory allocation over time.

methods.name: create_trace_view
methods.description: Creates a detailed trace view for a device.

methods.name: create_settings_view
methods.description: Displays allocator settings from snapshot.

methods.name: unpickle
methods.description: Attempts to decode data as JSON, falls back to unpickling.

methods.name: unpickleData
methods.description: Decodes a buffer using a custom unpickling implementation.

methods.name: add_snapshot
methods.description: Adds a snapshot to the cache and UI.

methods.name: finished_loading
methods.description: Processes loaded snapshot data.

methods.name: add_remote_files
methods.description: Fetches and loads remote snapshot files.

methods.name: add_local_files
methods.description: Loads local snapshot files.
